description: Phase 4 — Reactivity semantics. On handler return, re-evaluate and patch ONLY the affected hooked nodes' text/attributes for THAT instance — no vDOM, no full re-render, no re-run of setup. Enrich the hook record with build-time-compiled update instructions; freeze computed-backed (get*) runs at lowering time using the rootIdent rule so they are never blanked. Depends on FEAT-003 (per-instance glue + hook ids) and FEAT-001 (bareComputedKey).
steps: In src/codegen/html.ts add types UpdateInstr ({kind:'attr',name,expr:SerExpr} | {kind:'text',expr:SerExpr} | {kind:'attrTemplate',name,parts:SerPart[]} | {kind:'textTemplate',parts:SerPart[]}), SerExpr ({ident:string} | {member:SerExpr,prop:string}), SerPart ({lit:string} | {expr:SerExpr}); add `updates: UpdateInstr[]` to BindingHook. Export the new types from src/index.ts.

Widen hook emission (MEDIUM-5): emit a hook when a node has bindings OR events OR a single interpolated text run (its children are exactly one TextNode carrying >=1 {{expr}} part — the dominant

{{name}}

case). One hook carries that node's events[] AND its updates[] (attr updates from :prop bindings plus a text/textTemplate update from the single text run). Lower each AST Expr to SerExpr 1:1; a mixed literal+holes value becomes attrTemplate/textTemplate.

Define rootIdent(e: SerExpr): string that unwraps any member chain to its base ident (rootIdent({ident:'x'})='x'; rootIdent({member:{ident:'displayName'},prop:'length'})='displayName'). Build computedKeys = new Set(ctx.behavior.computed.map(bareComputedKey)) once per component (reuse the FEAT-001 helper).

Apply the freeze rule uniformly: emit NO UpdateInstr for a run where computedKeys.has(rootIdent(expr)) — for text use its single SerExpr; for textTemplate/attrTemplate freeze the whole run if ANY expr part's root ident is computed; for attr use its single SerExpr. Frozen runs stay build-time correct (like :for text). So {{displayName}}, {{displayName.foo}}, :src="displayName.url", and a mixed "{{displayName}} ({{count}})" are all frozen; only runs whose every ref roots in state/props/loop-local get an UpdateInstr. :for-unrolled nodes get events-only hooks (text/attrs frozen). An element with an @event plus state-backed {{count}} gets one hook with the event wired and a text UpdateInstr.

In src/codegen/glue.ts fill the runtime patch logic: emit the compiled HOOKS array (each hook's id template with {i}, its events, and its serialized updates). Add shared pure helpers evalExpr(e, state) (mirror src/expr/evaluate.ts ident/member walk over the single state object), toText (null/undefined -> ''), setOrRemoveAttr (remove on null/undefined), joinParts(parts, state), and applyUpdate(el, u, state). Each instance's rerender re-applies EVERY hook's updates against that instance's state, resolving nodes only within that instance's root (byHook scoped to root). Each wired listener is (event)=>{ globalThis.emit = emit; handler(state, event); rerender(); } with per-instance state/emit/rerender. The first rerender after hydration is a no-op for a deterministic setup.

Add unit tests (test/html-emit.test.ts or a new test/reactivity-lower.test.ts): emitter attaches correct updates for :src, {{name}}, and a template attr; SerExpr lowering round-trips; an element with BOTH @event and state-backed {{count}} -> one hook with the event and a text UpdateInstr; a :for-unrolled element with an event -> events-only hook (no text/attr updates); a computed {{displayName}} (from getDisplayName) -> hook with NO text update (frozen) while a sibling state {{count}} DOES get one; a member {{displayName.foo}} is frozen. Add test/reactivity.test.ts (jsdom): emit glue for a fixture, run under jsdom, dispatch a wired event -> state-backed text/attrs patch to mutated state; a getDisplayName-backed

{{displayName}}

is UNCHANGED (not blanked) after rerender; a :for item does not live-update.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` tsc-clean and `npm test` green including the new reactivity suites and all prior tests.
An element bound to state-backed {{count}} live-patches its textContent after a handler mutates state, with no vDOM and no setup re-run.
A computed-backed interpolation ({{displayName}} or {{displayName.foo}}) produces NO text/attr UpdateInstr and keeps its build-time value after rerender (never blanked).
A :for-unrolled node with an event gets an events-only hook; its text/attributes are not live-patched.
Patching is per-instance: dispatching an event on one instance never changes another instance's DOM.
findings:
SHIPPED. Phase 4 reactivity semantics complete. `npm run build` tsc-clean; `npm test` green at 165 tests (148 prior + 17 new: 13 reactivity-lower unit + 4 reactivity jsdom). eslint clean on all touched files. src/codegen/html.ts: - Added exported types SerExpr ({ident} | {member,prop}), SerPart ({lit} | {expr}), UpdateInstr (attr | text | attrTemplate | textTemplate). BindingHook gained REQUIRED `updates: UpdateInstr[]` (any code building a BindingHook literal must now supply it; none exist outside html.ts/glue.ts — compose.ts reuses emitHtml's EmitState, so untouched). - Exported helpers lowerExpr(Expr->SerExpr 1:1) and rootIdent(SerExpr->base ident, unwrapping member chains). Both exported from src/index.ts alongside the three new types. - EmitState gained `computedKeys: Set` built ONCE per emit in emitHtml via `new Set(ctx.behavior.computed.map(bareComputedKey))` (reuses the FEAT-001 helper, so Phase 1 scope.computed keys and Phase 4 freeze set agree byte-for-byte, incl. getURL->uRL). makeEmitParent shares the same EmitState so parent-owned projected slot nodes inherit the parent's computedKeys (correct — they bind against the parent scope). - Widened hook emission (MEDIUM-5): a hook now fires when node.bindings>0 OR node.events>0 OR singleInterpolatedTextRun(node)!=null (children are exactly ONE TextNode with >=1 {{expr}} part — the

{{name}}

case). A pure-literal text node, multiple children, or interpolation mixed with child ELEMENTS => no text update (returns null; build-time output still correct, live update skipped per design 'Addressability' limit). - Threaded a `loopLocal` boolean through emitElementMaybeFor->emitElement->emitPlainElement. :for-unrolled iterations pass loopLocal=true => their updates array is forced to [] (events-only hook; text/attrs build-time frozen, no structural reactivity). Non-loop path passes false. - buildUpdates(bindings, textRun, computedKeys): one attr/attrTemplate per :prop binding + one text/textTemplate for the single text run. FREEZE rule (HIGH-1) applied uniformly via isFrozen(e)=computedKeys.has(rootIdent(e)): text/attr frozen if its single SerExpr's root is computed; textTemplate/attrTemplate frozen if ANY hole's root is computed. A single bare {{expr}} text run => kind 'text'; a mixed literal+hole run => kind 'textTemplate' (same split for attrs). So {{displayName}}, {{displayName.foo}}, :src="displayName.url", and "{{displayName}} ({{count}})" are ALL frozen (no UpdateInstr); only all-state/props/loop-local runs get instructions. src/codegen/glue.ts: - HOOKS array now also carries each hook's `updates` and is filtered to hooks with events>0 OR updates>0 (a frozen text-only node contributes an empty hook that is dropped). The per-instance rerender loop (already wired in FEAT-003) now applies h.updates via applyUpdate. - Filled the former applyUpdate no-op stub with the shared, pure, module-level helpers: toText (null/undefined->''), evalExpr(e,state) (ident/member walk over the SINGLE state object, mirroring src/expr/evaluate.ts but state-only — the glue re-runs neither setup nor get*, and loop locals are build-time only), setOrRemoveAttr (removeAttribute on null/undefined, mirroring build-time 'omit attribute'), joinParts(parts,state), and applyUpdate(el,u,state) dispatching on u.kind. No vDOM, no createElement/innerHTML (glue-emit's 'never constructs DOM' test still green — helpers use textContent/setAttribute). - First rerender is naturally a no-op for deterministic setup: hydration only wires listeners (no rerender call on load); the first rerender happens on the first @event and re-applies against unchanged state => identical values. Per-instance scoping unchanged from FEAT-003 (byHook/rerender close over inst's root+state), so patching one instance never touches another. Tests: - test/reactivity-lower.test.ts (13): lowerExpr ident/member round-trip; rootIdent unwrap; attr update for :src; text update for {{name}}; attrTemplate for /u/{{slug}}; textTemplate for 'Hi {{name}}!'; BOTH @event+state {{count}} => one hook with event + text update; :for item + event => events-only (updates []); computed {{displayName}} frozen while sibling state {{count}} gets a text update; member {{displayName.foo}} frozen; mixed '{{displayName}} ({{count}})' frozen; computed :src frozen. - test/reactivity.test.ts (4, jsdom): state-backed {{count}} live-patches textContent after a mutating handler (0->1->2); state-backed :src live-patches; getDisplayName-backed

{{displayName}}

stays 'Ada' (NOT blanked) after rerender while sibling state {{count}} updates; a :for
  • does not live-update when state.items mutates. The jsdom harness writes behavior.js+glue.js to a per-test tmp dir and dynamic-imports the glue (emitGlue imports './behavior.js'). makeReactiveCtx takes an optional `computed` map so the

    build-time value is 'Ada' (the real pipeline populates scope.computed; the unit ctx must too). No prior test needed changing: existing html-emit/glue-emit assertions use [^>]*>/substring matches tolerant of the new data-adx-b on {{name}} nodes and the enriched HOOKS. Docs NOT touched (doc-sync is FEAT-006). Committed locally; not pushed.
